8.description: The quests to obtain Keeper Scrolls from the War Herald incorrectly required Profane Nethers and now require Lesser Profane Essence as intended. This change is live. If you still see Nether requirement be sure to clear your cache.

3.description: Reduced the network payload size of store pages (e.g https://ascension.gg/store/thrall/) by 88-92%. Bringing down their total bandwidth consumption down to 8-12% of the original size. This will be immediately noticeable when loading any realm store page without having cache already present on your device. This change is primarily targeting issues faced by those on slower or limited internet connections, but should still be plenty noticeable even on faster connections.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Demonic Persistence now also applies a pseudo buff to the player that mirrors the stacks of the buff applied to your pets (so its easier to track with addons like weak auras).

Reduced the timer of Criminal substantially. It will now be a max of 8 minutes. 3 Minutes on same faction attack. 5 Minutes on same faction kill. 8 Minutes on kill in town. This is down from 15 minutes.
Fixed the saving of your current raid lockout state on Thrall. It should now only reset when you reset the actual instance rather than reseting when simply reforming a group.

[Area 52] Implemented New abilities: Starsurge, Glaive Toss, Raging Blow, Lava Burst, Crimson Tempest, and Shadowflame.
Incanter's Absorption now supports Arcane Ward.
Added more hints to Worldforged Enchants.

Added Worldforged Caches. These caches are an alternative way to obtain existing Worldforged Enchants, they are unique caches hidden throughout the world in thematic locations to the Enchant they hold. These can be opened using Worldforged Keys that can be forged and obtained through a variety of content. This is intended to provide an alternative to obtaining some of the Worldforged that allows you to play the way you want to obtain them.

[Pending Restart] [ZulGurub] [Hakkar] Corrected an issue where Hakkars Blood Scythe (Mythic and Ascended only) would not increase the targets damage taken.
[Pending Restart] [ZulGurub] [Hakkar] The pools created by Corrupted Blood being dispelled now increase the damage dealt of Corrupted Blood by 400% up from 100% if a player remains standing in them.

Bloodlord Mandokir will only cast Level Up! when a kill got counted. Bloodlord Mandokir only gains progress towards his Legendary! state when a kill got counted.
[Pending Restart] [ZulGurub] [Bloodlord Mandokir] Corrected an issue where Bloodlord Mandokir would decapitate more targets then intended on higher player counts.

7.description: [Pending Restart] - [Pending Patch Update] - Poison Nova which costs energy, will now also be usable in Cat Form.

[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where the Fuego impact sound would have too high of a range.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the second hit of Saber Slash would cause you to gain far more Blood for the Blood God stacks than intended.

[Thrall] - [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue with the Fingers of Stone Mystic Enchantment was gaining too much benefit from critical strike damage talents. However, it now provides a buff that increases the critical strike damage of Stone Shard by 25% whenever Fingers of Stone is active.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - The Base Spell Power scaling of Feugo and Arctis has been reduced to 48% from 50%.

[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Winters Bite and Soul of the Feugo was both negatively and positively double dipping. This means it was stronger on bosses that had debuffs that increased damage taken and weaker on bosses that did not have such debuffs. Additionally, increased the targetting reliability of Soul of the Feugo and Winters Bite in AoE, but they lose 30% damage to the next target they hit. This means if I hit target 1 for 10,000, I will hit target 2 for 7,000, then target 3 for 4,900, this functionality is similar to Chain Lightning. This change is to mainly reign in the power of the enchantment while still giving remaining as a strong cleave option.

A level requirement has been added for enchantments such as Crusader, in order to decrease its relevance in early stages of the game such as Battlegrounds. Diminishing the power difference between users who owned their enchanted equipment and those who didn't.
Fixed some issues causing leveling scaling to not work as intended.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the feral weapon attack damage bonus would not always apply to Dire Bear Form.

[Pending restart] Fixed some issues with Burning Darkness. It has been slightly reworked, and now reads: Increases the duration of your Shadowflame ability by 2 seconds and doubles the Shadow damage bonus from Pyroclasm. Shadow Bolt damage done to targets affected by your Shadowflame is increased by 10%.
